editorial:
If you are in the mood for a fast, no-nonsense action movie with a heart, this one delivers. Jason Statham plays Luke Wright, a former elite agent who has hit rock bottom. When he crosses paths with Mei, a 12-year-old Chinese girl who has been kidnapped because she holds a secret code in her head, he decides to protect her. That decision throws them into a messy war between Triads, the Russian Mafia, and corrupt New York City cops and politicians. The story moves quickly, and the chemistry between Statham and the young actress keeps you invested even when the plot gets a little wild.

The action scenes are sharp and easy to follow, with plenty of hand-to-hand fights and shootouts that never drag. Statham is in his comfort zone here, playing a tough guy with a soft spot, and it works. The movie does lean on some familiar cliches, and the villains can feel a bit cartoonish at times. Still, if you want a solid popcorn thriller that does not waste your time, this is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Luke and Mei manage to outsmart all three groups fighting over her. Luke uses the code Mei memorized to access a hidden safe, then destroys the information so no one can use it again. He kills the corrupt mayor and the Russian mob boss, while the Triad leader is taken down. With the bad guys gone, Luke promises to keep Mei safe and takes her in, giving her a real home and a fresh start away from the criminal world.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Jason Statham action movies and gritty crime thrillers.
